title: Make it clear when one network/VPN was automatically connected as a precondition of connecting to another one
line: A VPN that connected automatically together with a network now says "Connected automatically with <network>" in the Networks widget.
explanation: NetworkManager's only notion of one connection depending on another is a connection's secondaries list (the editor's "Automatically connect to VPN" option): activating the network also brings up the listed VPN. The Networks widget showed such a VPN exactly like one connected by hand, with only a download/upload line that is always 0 B/s for VPNs, so there was no way to tell why it was connected. The model now records, for each active connection, the active connection whose secondaries list contains it, and the applet shows "Connected automatically with <name>" as that item's subtitle.

commits.message:
applet: show when a connection was started automatically by another one

A VPN set to connect automatically with a network looked just like one
connected by hand, so it wasn't clear why it was on. Its subtitle now
says "Connected automatically with" followed by that network's name.

BUG: 497750
